## Head-to-Head Comparison

| Dimension | Kestra | n8n | Verdict |
|-----------|--------|-----|---------|
| **License** | Apache 2.0 (OSI-approved) [1] | Sustainable Use License (not OSI) [n8n-14] | **Kestra stronger** — true open source |
| **Architecture** | Java/Micronaut, YAML workflows [1][34] | TypeScript/Node.js, JSON workflows [n8n-3] | Different stacks, comparable |
| **Self-hosting** | Docker, Podman, standalone JAR, K8s [5][6][7] | Docker, npm, K8s [n8n-9] | **Kestra stronger** — Podman + JAR options |
| **CLI/Script execution** | 13 languages, Process runner, structured output capture [10][11] | JavaScript + Python Code nodes only [n8n-40] | **Kestra much stronger** — native shell, 13 languages |
| **Credential isolation** | secret() function, env vars (OSS), external managers (EE) [19][21] | AES256 encryption, Vault/AWS (Enterprise) [n8n-33][n8n-35] | Comparable; both limit secrets to Enterprise for external managers |
| **Scheduling** | Cron, timezone, backfill, conditional, L-day-of-month [16] | Cron via Cron trigger node [n8n-3] | **Kestra stronger** — backfill recovery, conditional scheduling |
| **REST API** | Full CRUD, OpenAPI 3.0.1 spec [17][36] | REST API at /rest/workflows [n8n-39] | Comparable |
| **Webhooks** | URL key + Basic Auth, sync response, body/headers access [18] | Webhook node with response, auth options [n8n-41] | Comparable |
| **Execution history** | Full persistence, Gantt, topology, Debug Expression, AI fix [22] | Execution list, per-node inspection [n8n-3] | **Kestra stronger** — richer debugging tools |
| **Retry/error handling** | 3 strategies, task/flow-level, global defaults, namespace errors [14][15] | Retry with backoff, Error Trigger, DLQ pattern [n8n-29] | Comparable; n8n has DLQ pattern |
| **AI/LLM** | 8+ native providers, AI agents, MCP client+server [24][25][26] | 70+ LangChain nodes, 11 providers, MCP [n8n-2][n8n-23] | **n8n stronger** — deeper LangChain integration, more AI nodes |
| **Community** | 26.7k stars, Apple/JPMorgan adopters, $36M funding [1][3] | 150k+ stars, $2.5B valuation, $254M funding [n8n-1][n8n-11] | **n8n stronger** — larger community and funding |
| **Workflow definition** | YAML (declarative) [2] | JSON via visual editor [n8n-3] | Kestra: code-first. n8n: visual-first |
| **Resource footprint** | 4 GiB minimum [8] | ~100MB idle, 4GB recommended [n8n-43] | **n8n lighter** at idle |
| **Integrations** | 1,200+ plugins [3] | 400+ built-in + 5,800 community [n8n-8] | n8n has more variety; Kestra has more plugins total |
| **Pricing (cloud)** | Not yet launched (Kestra Cloud upcoming) [3] | $24/month starter [n8n-9] | n8n has established cloud option |

*n8n citation numbers prefixed with "n8n-" refer to the n8n analysis citations.*

## Key Differentiators

### Where Kestra Wins

1. **True open source.** Apache 2.0 vs n8n's Sustainable Use License. No
   commercial restrictions. Can fork, modify, redistribute freely.

2. **CLI/Script execution is first-class.** 13 languages with native task
   types. Process runner executes directly on host. Structured output capture
   pattern (::{"outputs":{...}}::). This is the #1 requirement and Kestra
   handles it natively — n8n requires a Code node limited to JavaScript/Python.

3. **YAML-as-code.** Flows are Git-versionable YAML files. n8n stores
   workflows as JSON blobs primarily edited through the visual UI. For an
   engineer who thinks in code, Kestra's approach is more natural.

4. **Podman support.** Officially documented and tested. n8n has no official
   Podman documentation.

5. **Scheduling features.** Backfill recovery (ALL/LAST/NONE), conditional
   scheduling (weekday/weekend/holiday), stuck trigger detection. n8n's Cron
   trigger is simpler.

### Where n8n Wins

1. **AI/LLM integration depth.** 70+ LangChain-integrated AI nodes vs
   Kestra's ~10 native LLM task types. n8n has 12 vector store backends
   for RAG, 8 memory backends, multi-agent patterns built into the visual
   canvas.

2. **Community size.** 150k+ GitHub stars vs 26.7k. $2.5B valuation vs
   undisclosed. Larger ecosystem of community contributions.

3. **Resource footprint.** n8n idles at ~100MB. Kestra requires minimum 4 GiB.
   On a personal workstation, this matters.

4. **Visual workflow builder.** For someone who prefers drag-and-drop over
   YAML, n8n's editor is more accessible.

5. **Template library.** 8,300+ templates including 6,137 AI-specific ones.
   Kestra has blueprints but fewer community templates.

### Where They're Equivalent

- REST API capabilities (both have CRUD + execution management)
- Webhook triggering (both support sync responses)
- Basic retry/error handling (both have configurable retry strategies)
- MCP support (both have client and server capabilities)

## Fit for Personal Assistant Requirements

| Requirement | Kestra | n8n |
|------------|--------|-----|
| 1. Shell/CLI execution | Native, 13 languages, Process runner | Limited to Code node (JS/Python) |
| 2. Credential isolation | secret() function, server-side resolution | AES256 encrypted credentials |
| 3. Self-hosted, single workstation | Podman documented, 4 GiB min | Docker, ~100MB idle |
| 4. API-driven management | Full REST API + OpenAPI spec | REST API at /rest/* |
| 5. Cron scheduling | Full cron + backfill + conditional | Basic cron |
| 6. Execution history | Rich UI with Gantt, topology, debug | Basic execution list |
| 7. Retry with backoff | 3 strategies, global defaults | Retry with backoff |
| 8. Webhook triggers | Built-in with sync response | Webhook node |
| 9. Licensing | Apache 2.0 (OSI) | Sustainable Use License (not OSI) |
| 10. AI/LLM integration | Native plugins (nice-to-have) | Deep LangChain (nice-to-have) |

**Assessment:** For this specific use case (CLI-centric, credential-isolated,
single-workstation), Kestra is the stronger fit. The #1 requirement
(shell/CLI execution) is where Kestra most clearly outperforms n8n.

## Gaps and Limitations

- This comparison relies on the n8n analysis from 2026-03-30 and Kestra
  research from 2026-04-07; both platforms evolve rapidly
- n8n resource consumption figures are from practitioner reports, not official
  benchmarks
- Kestra's 4 GiB minimum may be conservative — actual idle usage could be
  lower but is not documented
